episode_title: Episode 285: Cut A Rug: Bringing a Unique Art Experience to Huntsville with Brent Hobbs

real_qa.q: What is Cut A Rug Tufting and how does the workshop experience work in Huntsville?
real_qa.r: Cut A Rug Tufting is a workshop-style art class at Lone Mill where customers learn to make their own rugs using tufting guns, similar to the videos seen on TikTok. Participants receive instruction from Brent Hobbs and take home a finished rug. The experience accommodates groups of four to six people maximum, though single-person classes are also available, and the studio operates with a high foot traffic location that attracts walk-in customers.
real_qa.requete: Cut A Rug Tufting Huntsville rug workshop

real_qa.q: How many Christmas vacation cat rugs has Brent Hobbs hand-made and sold on Etsy since creating the design?
real_qa.r: Brent Hobbs has made approximately 2700 Christmas vacation cat rugs by hand, all cut out with scissors. These rugs feature the scene from National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation where the cat chews the lights and gets fried, and they sell primarily between October and Christmas. Each rug takes about 15 minutes to make from start to finish, and they are sold on Etsy under the shop name B Creative Dad.
real_qa.requete: Christmas vacation cat rug Brent Hobbs 2700

real_qa.q: What was Brent Hobbs' feature in Garden and Gun magazine and how did it impact Cut A Rug?
real_qa.r: Brent Hobbs was featured in Garden and Gun magazine in a write-up about Huntsville as a travel destination, which generated significant traction and recognition for Cut A Rug Tufting. This publication brought visibility to his business since opening at Lone Mill.
real_qa.requete: Garden and Gun magazine Brent Hobbs Huntsville

real_qa.q: How long has Brent Hobbs been operating Cut A Rug Tufting at Lone Mill in Huntsville?
real_qa.r: Brent Hobbs has been at Lone Mill for approximately two years and four months. He initially started on the third floor and moved to his current location on the first floor of the South building about a year and a little over a year ago, chosen for its high foot traffic visibility.
real_qa.requete: Cut A Rug Tufting Lone Mill Huntsville location hours

real_qa.q: What are Brent Hobbs' future goals for Cut A Rug, including private events and new art forms?
real_qa.r: Brent Hobbs plans to expand Cut A Rug by offering private event services where he brings a slimmed-down version of the tufting workshop to corporate locations for team-building exercises and employee benefits. He is also exploring paint pouring workshops on collectible vinyl bear figures as a way to accommodate younger children under age 14, who currently cannot participate in the tufting classes.
real_qa.requete: Cut A Rug Tufting private events expansion 2025

guest.bio_context: Brent Hobbs graduated from UAH in 2006 with a bachelor's degree in fine arts, specifically graphic design. He worked in freelance graphic design and pop culture art at comic cons for approximately 20 years before returning to creative pursuits. He has been making rugs for about eight to ten years, initially selling them as gifts, before opening Cut A Rug Tufting workshop at Lone Mill in Huntsville approximately two years and four months ago.
